rich_text_fields.html: Union Minister of Ports, Shipping and Waterways (MoPSW), Shri Sarbananda Sonowal toured The Energy and Resources Institute's (TERI) Gwal Pahari campus and reviewed a series of green shipping initiatives, positioning the sector's decarbonisation as a priority area for his ministry.
